description_en: Queries the list of LLM templates
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-llm-templates --model-template-id mt-xxxx --provider-template-id mpt-xxxx --llm-template-ids llmt-xxxx --llm-code qwen3.6-plus --smart-model false --biz-type 1 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLlmTemplates

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated model group
parameters.name: model_template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the model provider template
parameters.help_zh: 所属模型服务商模板 ID
parameters.name: provider_template_id

parameters.help_en: The model template IDs used for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 模型模板 ID 筛选
parameters.name: llm_template_ids

parameters.help_en: The model code filter. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 模型编码筛选，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: llm_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query smart models. If set to true, only LLMs under system preset smart models are returned, and BizType is required. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否查智能模型：true-只返回系统预置智能模型下的LLM（此时BizType必传），不传默认false
parameters.name: smart_model

parameters.help_en: The business type. This parameter is required when SmartModel is set to true
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. Values 0 and 1 return the same result
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从1开始，0和1返回相同结果
parameters.name: page_number

Data.description_en: The list of returned data objects

Config.description_zh: 模型配置 JSON 对象

CreditMultiplier.description_en: The credit consumption multiplier (rate). A null value indicates that the model does not participate in credit-based billing
CreditMultiplier.description_zh: 积分消耗系数（倍率）。为空表示该模型不参与积分计费

Max.description_en: The maximum multiplier. A null value indicates no upper limit. For example, Min=1 with Max as null is displayed as 1x and above
Max.description_zh: 倍率上限。为空表示无上限，如 Min=1、Max 为空展示为 1x 起
Max.title_en: 倍率上限。为空表示无上限，如 Min=1、Max 为空展示为 1x 起
Max.title_zh: 倍率上限。为空表示无上限，如 Min=1、Max 为空展示为 1x 起

Min.description_en: The minimum multiplier. When equal to Max, it represents a fixed multiplier. For example, Min=Max=2 is displayed as 2x
Min.description_zh: 倍率下限。与 Max 相等时为固定倍率，如 Min=Max=2 展示为 2x
Min.title_en: 倍率下限。与 Max 相等时为固定倍率，如 Min=Max=2 展示为 2x
Min.title_zh: 倍率下限。与 Max 相等时为固定倍率，如 Min=Max=2 展示为 2x

CreditMultiplier.title_en: 积分消耗系数（倍率）。为空表示该模型不参与积分计费
CreditMultiplier.title_zh: 积分消耗系数（倍率）。为空表示该模型不参与积分计费

Features.description_en: The list of model features, such as function-calling, web-search, and structured-outputs

InferenceMetadata.description_en: The inference metadata, including request and response modalities
InferenceMetadata.description_zh: 推理元数据（请求和响应模态）

RequestModality.description_en: The list of request modalities, such as Text, Image, and Audio

ResponseModality.description_en: The list of response modalities, such as Text, Image, and Audio

InferenceMetadata.title_en: 推理元数据（请求和响应模态）
InferenceMetadata.title_zh: 推理元数据（请求和响应模态）

IsDefaultModel.description_en: Indicates whether this is the default model under the associated model group
IsDefaultModel.description_zh: 是否为关联模型分组下的默认模型

ModelInfo.description_en: The model information, including context window size and maximum input/output tokens
ModelInfo.description_zh: 模型信息（上下文窗口大小、最大输入/输出 tokens 等）
ModelInfo.title_en: 模型信息（上下文窗口大小、最大输入/输出 tokens 等）
ModelInfo.title_zh: 模型信息（上下文窗口大小、最大输入/输出 tokens 等）

Prices.description_en: The list of prices within the range

Price.description_en: The price in string format, such as 0.2

PriceName.description_en: The price name, such as Input, Output, or Image Generation
PriceName.description_zh: 价格名称（如：输入、输出、图片生成）
PriceName.title_en: 价格名称（如：输入、输出、图片生成）
PriceName.title_zh: 价格名称（如：输入、输出、图片生成）

PriceUnit.description_en: The price unit, such as per image or per thousand tokens

RangeName.description_en: The range name, such as Default or 0-1M tokens

ProviderTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the model provider template
ProviderTemplateId.description_zh: 所属模型服务商模板 ID

PublishedTime.description_en: The publish time in ISO 8601 format, such as 2026-03-04T06:25:17.000+00:00

RefScope.description_en: The authorization scope of the associated model group. Valid values: ALL_USER (all users), USER_MIXED (specified users and user groups), RESOURCE_MIXED (specified resources). Returned only when SmartModel is set to true
RefScope.description_zh: 所属模型分组的授权范围：ALL_USER（全部用户）/ USER_MIXED（指定用户及用户组）/ RESOURCE_MIXED（指定资源）。仅当 SmartModel 为 true 时返回

RoutePolicyCount.description_zh: 路由策略数：该模型档位下已配置的路由策略条数。仅当 SmartModel 为 true 时返回，未配置策略的档位返回 0

PageNumber.description_zh: 当前展示的查询结果页码
